title: M6 actual normalized coefficient signed-width safety

spec.name: M6.Transfer.division_difference_fits
spec.statement: ∀ (R N : ℕ) (z w : ℤ) (j k : ℕ), z.natAbs ≤ 2^R*8^N → w.natAbs ≤ 2^R*8^N → (z/(2:ℤ)^j - w/(2:ℤ)^k).natAbs < 2^(M6.Transfer.queryCoefficientBits R N - 1)
spec.guidance: Use Int.natAbs_ediv_le_natAbs and the triangle bound on subtraction, then actual_signed_capacity and queryCoefficientBits=coefficientBits+2. For actual Q, unfold Q and Normalize.divide_coeff. Each trace is scalarTracePolynomial; rewrite scalar_trace_polynomial using actual boundary_edge_bounds or character_edge_bounds for degree, then apply trace_coefficient_bound with their mass bound. No oracle premise or stronger physical conditions. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualTransfer.query_coefficients_fit
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N)) (d : ℕ), ((M6.ActualTransfer.Q N a b P).coeff d).natAbs < 2^(M6.Transfer.queryCoefficientBits (M6.ActualTransfer.span a b) N - 1)
